name: s1_mascot_sword
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game unit sprite shown small (about 90 px)
Subject: a cat mascot shaped like a soft round rice cake (a plump bean / loaf body with almost no neck), tiny stubby paws, small triangular ears, a short tail. Orange tabby with only three simple stripes on the forehead. Face: two small solid black dot eyes set far apart, a tiny pink nose, a small 'w' mouth. NO sparkles in the eyes, NO eyelashes, NO big anime eyes. It wears a plain red scarf and holds one tiny wooden sword in a stubby paw.

Composition: full body, front view, centred, generous padding, no ground shadow.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha).
Constraints: single character, no hat, no text, no watermark.
